scenes.title: The Euphoria & The Borrowed Wire
scenes.purpose: Establish retail market euphoria on mobile screens, stepping through demographic adoption, surging balances, and the hidden time bomb of 3x borrowed margin debt.
scenes.visual: A light frosted smartphone interface opens with a rising green candlestick chart, demographic tags pop as narration names them, portfolio counter surges to +¥45k, and an amber margin financing drawer reveals 75% borrowed debt.

layout.portrait: Top telemetry HUD, center hero mobile viewport with rising green chart and badges, bottom margin debt meter

transition_out.continuity: Transparent cut into Scene 2 market tremor threshold

scenes.title: The Trap Snaps
scenes.purpose: Show the shock of a 2% dip instantly breaching collateral thresholds, draining the liquidation gauge, firing broker push alerts, and executing an automated sell-all order.
scenes.visual: A bright red breach line shatters the trend, the collateral equity gauge rapidly drains from ¥160,000 to ¥0, three urgent margin call alerts slide in, and a broker involuntary liquidation stamp locks.

layout.portrait: Upper red tremor tag, center radial liquidation gauge, cascading broker alerts, bottom execution stamp

transition_out.continuity: Transparent cut into the 90% retail order book vacuum

scenes.title: The Human Stampede
scenes.purpose: Dramatize the 90% retail market structure, the evaporation of buy-side liquidity, thirty million panic sell orders, and the index plunging into freefall.
scenes.visual: A split comparison highlights 90% retail dominance, buy-side liquidity drains to 0%, a waterfall of crimson order shards pours down the screen, and sell orders are rejected as the index plunges.

layout.portrait: Upper retail dominance badge, center order-book depth meter with plunging vector, bottom interactive sell rejection tag

transition_out.continuity: Transparent cut into the state stabilization attempt

scenes.title: The Broken Spell
scenes.purpose: Demonstrate state bailout failure against loss of confidence, rolling up to the monumental -$2.4T equity loss and concluding takeaway hold.
scenes.visual: An emerald state rescue barrier attempts to arrest the drop but shatters under selling pressure, leading into a monumental frosted card with -$2.4T rolling counter and the concluding takeaway quote.

layout.portrait: Monumental centered takeaway card with animated rules, hero counter, and breathing focus aura

transition_out.continuity: Final monumental card holds motionless with subtle breathing pulse to completion
